default.question: Is LoomIQ designed for garment manufacturers?
default.answer: Yes. LoomIQ is positioned specifically for garment and clothing manufacturers, bringing orders, inventory, production, and accounts into one ERP.

default.question: Can a small manufacturer buy online?
default.answer: Yes. Starter and Growth can be purchased on this website without a sales call. Review pricing and the setup conditions before paying.

default.question: What is the difference between Starter and Growth?
default.answer: The regular monthly prices are {starterRegular} and {growthRegular}. Detailed user limits and verified module entitlements have not been supplied; confirm any essential feature or limit with support before choosing a plan.

default.question: Can I manage production, inventory, and orders?
default.answer: These are core areas of the product brief. The current preview does not demonstrate garment-specific screens. Confirm your required production workflow before purchasing.

default.question: Does LoomIQ support job work, employees, or cutting and stitching stages?
default.answer: Those detailed capabilities have not yet been verified in the available product materials. Do not assume they are included in either plan.

default.question: Can I import my existing spreadsheets?
default.answer: An ERP data-import workflow and migration terms have not been supplied. Ask support about your data format and migration needs before purchase.

default.question: Is LoomIQ cloud-based?
default.answer: This website and customer account run in your browser. The team provides your ERP workspace link after setup; confirm deployment requirements if these matter to your factory.

default.question: What happens immediately after payment?
default.answer: After Razorpay confirms payment, you can view and save your invoice. Your customer account shows onboarding progress. Our team arranges ERP access; payment does not instantly create a workspace.

default.question: Do I need technical knowledge? Is onboarding included?
default.answer: The current plans describe onboarding support. You can track setup in your account. A setup completion time and training scope have not been specified.

default.question: How does the first-purchase offer work?
default.answer: Eligible first purchases receive {discount} off within 24 hours of the first offer visit: Starter {starterOffer} or Growth {growthOffer} for one month. The server records the deadline; refreshing does not restart it. Trial accounts can qualify if they have not purchased.

default.question: How do payments and renewals work?
default.answer: Pay the INR total displayed at checkout through Razorpay. Each purchase covers one membership month. This website does not automatically charge for renewal.

default.question: Can I cancel or get a refund?
default.answer: There is no automatic renewal to cancel. The existing refund policy says discounted first-month payments are generally non-refundable. Email support with your order reference for payment or service issues; read the full refund policy before purchase.

default.question: How is my account protected?
default.answer: Customer accounts use hashed passwords, expiring sessions, and password recovery. Invoices require the purchasing account. Razorpay handles payment details. These website controls do not establish a security certification for the ERP.

default.question: How do I get support?
default.answer: Use the support request form to contact the team. After purchase, the confirmation page also provides the form. No response-time guarantee is published.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy describes the information used for LoomIQ accounts, demo and trial requests, membership purchases, support, and website analytics.
sections: Information we collect

We collect the contact and company details you submit, a password hash for your account, billing address and phone number at checkout, payment references, invoices, and messages you send to support. We store visitor and session identifiers in essential cookies. Card details are handled by Razorpay rather than stored by this website.
How we use information

We use this information to authenticate accounts, manage offer eligibility, arrange demos and onboarding, confirm payments, provide invoices, respond to support requests, and protect the service from abuse.
Service providers and analytics

Our hosting, database, email, and payment providers process information needed to deliver the service. With optional analytics consent, Google Analytics and, when configured, Meta Pixel receive page views and conversion events, including purchased plan, amount, currency, and an order event identifier. Custom events exclude your form fields and payment instrument details. Change your preference using Analytics settings in the footer.
Retention and requests

Account, inquiry, and transaction records are retained to operate the service and maintain payment records. To request access, correction, or deletion, use the support form. We may need to verify account ownership and retain records needed for unresolved transactions or applicable recordkeeping obligations.
Account security
Keep your password and email account secure. Password reset links expire after 30 minutes and can be used once. Resetting your password invalidates existing login sessions.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.intro: These terms describe website use, account registration, membership checkout, and the onboarding process for LoomIQ.
sections: Website content
LoomIQ provides this website and preview content for general informational purposes. Product details, features, and availability may change as our platform evolves.
Demo requests
Submitting a demo request does not create a customer relationship, guarantee product access, pricing, or final contract terms unless expressly agreed in writing.
Accounts

Provide accurate contact and billing information and keep your login credentials private. Contact support if you suspect unauthorized access. Do not use the website to interfere with other accounts or the operation of the service.
Membership payments

Checkout purchases one membership month at the amount displayed before payment. This website does not automatically charge for later months. Additional purchases require a new checkout. Payment confirmation and invoices are available in your account.
Offer conditions

The first-purchase discount lasts 24 hours from the first offer visit and does not restart on refresh. Trial accounts can qualify if they have not purchased. Payment must complete before the order deadline; late captured discounted payments are submitted for refund.
Access and onboarding

Creating an account or making a payment does not instantly create an ERP workspace. Our team arranges onboarding and provides access after setup. Your account shows progress and a workspace link when access is ready. Contact support to agree on setup and service dates before purchase if timing is essential.
Support and billing questions
Use the support form for account, payment, or service questions. The Refund Policy describes cancellation requests and payment issues.

refunds.title: Refund & Cancellation Policy
refunds.intro: This policy explains one-time membership payments, cancellation requests, and payment refunds.
sections: One-time payments
Each checkout purchases one membership month. There are no automatic renewals or automatic charges from this website. To purchase another month, complete a new checkout at the displayed price.
Cancellation

You do not need to cancel an automatic renewal. For an existing membership, onboarding cancellation, or an access issue, contact support with your account email and order reference so the team can review your request.
Refunds

The discounted first-month payment is generally non-refundable after payment. If you believe a payment was made in error or a service issue affected your account, contact support promptly so the request can be reviewed.
Expired offer payments

Captured discounted payments completed after their order deadline are submitted to Razorpay for a full refund. A submitted refund may take time to reach your payment method. Contact support with your payment reference if you need a status update.
Support
For cancellation or billing help, use the support form with your account email and company name.
